# Pipeline (פייפליין)

> Pipeline is a web and Android app that turns raw Hebrew talking-head footage into a social-ready video: accurate Hebrew transcription, word-synced captions with correct right-to-left (RTL) rendering, silence cutting, an AI opening hook, matched stock B-roll, and audio/video enhancement. It is built specifically for Hebrew speech and Hebrew text.

## Key facts

- What it does: automatic Hebrew subtitles/captions and one-click video editing for short-form content (Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, Facebook, LinkedIn), vertical or horizontal.
- Hebrew-first: transcription runs on a Whisper model tuned for Hebrew (ivrit.ai) plus an AI proofreading pass that fixes Hebrew mishearings; captions render right-to-left correctly, word-synced, with karaoke and word-by-word modes, style presets, fonts and colors.
- Editing: silence and filler-word cutting, AI-generated opening hook text, automatic stock B-roll matched to what is said, auto punch-in zoom, speech audio enhancement, video upscaling.
- Output: rendered MP4 ready for publishing, SRT subtitle export, direct scheduling to social networks via Metricool.
- Pricing: the first 3 videos are free with no credit card; afterwards prepaid credit packs (10/30/100 credits). No subscription required.
- Platforms: Web app at https://hebrew-pipeline.app, Android on Google Play (package com.heb.pipeline), iPhone version planned.
- Audience: Hebrew-speaking content creators, marketers, coaches and small business owners who publish spoken-Hebrew video.
- Interface languages: Hebrew and English.
- Contact: hebrewpipeline@gmail.com

## Common questions it answers

- How do I add automatic Hebrew subtitles to a video? (איך מוסיפים כתוביות אוטומטיות בעברית לסרטון)
- Which app adds accurate Hebrew captions to Reels/TikTok/Shorts? (אפליקציה לכתוביות בעברית לרילס/טיקטוק)
- How do I get Hebrew captions that render right-to-left correctly?
- How do I transcribe Hebrew speech to text for a video? (תמלול בעברית לסרטון)
